shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "pwd && rg --files -g '"'!node_modules'"' -g '"'!package-lock.json'"' -g '"'!yarn.lock'"' -g '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' | head -80"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md'
/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,95p' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && rg -n -C 3 'charts|chartkit' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat package.json src/App.tsx src/main.tsx && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && cat AGENTS.md'

/bin/bash -lc 'ls -a && npm view @gravity-ui/charts version peerDependencies && .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeType Button Select SegmentedRadioGroup Text'
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -C 4 'useTheme|useThemeType|ThemeProvider|background|spacing|dark|system' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/theming.md | head -155"
/bin/bash -lc 'npm install @gravity-ui/charts@1.73.0'

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh uikit ThemeProvider useTheme useThemeType Button Select SegmentedRadioGroup Text && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/README.md'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/{useTheme,useThemeType,useThemeSettings,useThemeContext}.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/SegmentedRadioGroup/{SegmentedRadioGroup,SegmentedRadioGroupOption}.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Button/Button.d.ts && sed -n '1,150p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Select/types.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc 'bash .agents/skills/gravity-ui/scripts/inspect-package.sh charts Chart ChartData && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/README.md && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme/{types,ThemeSettingsContext}.d.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/INDEX.md && rg -n 'color|dash|lineWidth|marker|legend|xAxis|yAxis|tooltip' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/chart-config.d.ts | head -55 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Text/Text.d.ts"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/theming.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/series-types/line.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/colors.md && sed -n '1,145p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-labels.md && sed -n '1,110p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/legend.md"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n 'ChartData|ChartProps|LineSeries|dashStyle|lineWidth|tickInterval|tickPixelInterval' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/{index.d.ts,types,components} -g '*.d.ts' | head -65 && rg -n -A 24 'interface ControlProps|interface ControlGroupProps' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/types.d.ts && cat tsconfig.json"

/bin/bash -lc "cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/index.d.ts && rg --files node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm | rg '(line/types|types/(chart|axis|series)|series/line)' | head -35 && rg -n 'export (interface|type) (LineSeries|ChartData|ChartXAxis|ChartYAxis)|dashStyle\\??:|lineWidth\\??:|tickPixelInterval\\??:' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.d.ts' | head -65 && cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/axes/axis-types.md"

/bin/bash -lc "sed -n '1,155p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/line.d.ts && sed -n '150,245p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts && sed -n '1,105p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/index.d.ts && rg -n -C 2 'DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/base.d.ts && rg -n 'color.*var\\(|getComputedStyle|css.*color' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.js' | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 16 'enum DashStyle|type DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants.d.ts; rg -n 'grid|padding|tick|format' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts | head -32; rg -n 'color.*var\\(|getComputedStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm -g '*.js' | head -18; sed -n '1,100p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/docs/guides/tooltip.md; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -45"

/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 13 'DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants/base.d.ts; sed -n '1,90p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/chart.d.ts; sed -n '245,261p' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/axis.d.ts; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/types/chart/tooltip.d.ts | head -60"
/bin/bash -lc "rg -n -A 15 'enum DashStyle|type DashStyle' node_modules/@gravity-ui/charts/dist/esm/core/constants -g '*.d.ts'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat src/main.tsx && head -8 src/App.tsx && ls src && git status --short'
